risks.risk: Dependence on the health of portfolio / investee companies
risks.note: MD&A Risks and Concerns states the Company's business performance is inherently influenced by the operational and financial health of its portfolio companies; challenges from macroeconomic headwinds, market volatility or internal disruptions within the investee entities may adversely affect returns and overall performance. As a Core Investment Company whose main objective is to invest in securities mainly of group companies, earnings are structurally concentrated in a small set of group entities.

The Company, being an Investment Company, seeks opportunities in the capital market, and the MD&A states the unpredictability in the stock market represents both opportunity as well as challenges. Equity markets are also navigating valuation pressures, especially in mid- and small-cap segments, which may see corrections — directly affecting the value of the investment book.

risks.risk: Financial risk set specific to an investment/NBFC business
risks.note: MD&A explicitly lists exposure to market risk, credit risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk, equity risk, operational risk, currency risk, and regulatory and macro-economic risks arising from the respective businesses in which the group entities operate.

risks.risk: Regulatory tightening and CIC/NBFC compliance burden
risks.note: MD&A flags regulatory tightening around derivatives, co-lending and high-frequency trading introducing short-term compliance adjustments, particularly for NBFCs and institutional investors; the Outlook adds that navigating the evolving regulatory landscape will be crucial. The Company itself operates as a CIC under RBI guidelines and its three operating subsidiaries are registered NBFCs.

risks.risk: Geopolitical tension, commodity-price volatility and inflation
risks.note: MD&A states geopolitical tensions, volatility in commodity prices, inflationary pressures and changes in global monetary policies may adversely affect investor sentiment and capital flows into emerging markets, including India; margin pressures and geopolitical developments continue to weigh on business confidence. Cross-border emergencies and wars are separately flagged as affecting the business.

risks.risk: Rupee depreciation and elevated oil prices
risks.note: MD&A states the rupee's depreciation and persistent inflationary pressures, driven by elevated oil prices, could impact corporate profitability and sentiment; currency depreciation and US trade tariff volatility are named among the threats in a highly polarized Indian capital market.

risks.risk: Competitive pricing pressure in the food-processing business
risks.note: MD&A names market competition that forces the Company to sell its product at low cost as a threat, and states this 'also led to loss to the Company' — corroborated by the associate Morton Foods Limited's loss widening as cost of goods sold rose from 46% to 56% of sales.

risks.risk: Agricultural raw-material and natural-calamity exposure in food processing
risks.note: MD&A states raw material is based on agricultural produce which is affected by natural calamities, deteriorating product quality — described as the major threat to the business.
